name: Would you like to run an idol café?
source: After failing to get into the university of his choice, Naoya puts his further education on hold to take a job at a quaint seaside café. There, he meets two cute waitresses, and he becomes more intimately involved in their lives than he anticipated.
translation: 没能考上理想大学后，Naoya暂缓升学，在一家别致的海滨咖啡馆找了份工作。在那里，他遇见两位可爱的女服务员，与她们的生活产生了比预想更深的联系。
